services.desc: Your admission is purchased at the gift shop when you make your reservation. Purchases made in the Gift Shop are very important to the Mission. We do not receive any financial aid from any state or federal funds. We rely solely on the generosity of our visitors for the upkeep and restoration of this historic treasure. STUDENTS MAY NOT BRING BACKPACKS, drinks, or food onto the Mission grounds. Teachers and chaperones may carry their educational supplies (no food or drink) as needed. STUDENTS MUST STAY WITH THEIR CHAPERONE AT ALL TIMES. The PDF of chaperone guidelines are available by clicking here. THE MISSION IS A PLACE OF WORSHIP. There are times when the Church may be closed for services.
